usedFor: Evoliz holds your invoices, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command” after each “New Invoice”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Evoliz, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new invoice can start a script on your own machine, such as a local backup or print job.

watchOut: “New Invoice” in Evoliz is polling over a recent time window, so the command runs after a scheduled check.
